newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Monday with no fresh deals reported, traders said.
"There are bids at 49.75 U.S. cents/lb here, but traders believe it's just too low. Many traders wish to sell rubber at at least 50.00 U.S. cents/lb," said one trader in North Sumatran city of Medan.
He said a lack of fresh factors had dampened market sentiment while consumer demand continued to be weak. "The market is pretty quiet today and we haven't struck any fresh deals," he added.
